title: Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC: Incorrect Certification Label/Part 567 (10 affected)

The actual Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) is 16,000lbs  but was listed as 18,000lbs on the label.  Thus, these vehicles fail to conform to Part 567, "Certification Regulation."

title: Oreion Motors LLC.: Ungoverned Speed/Missing Reflectors/Incorrect GVWR (526 affected)

Thus, these vehicles fail to conform to the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 500, "Low Speed Vehicles."  Additionally, the Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) of the vehicle was incorrectly listed on the certification label which is a violation of Part 567, "Certification."
